extracted.name: Ground Beef Goulash
extracted.description: Set it and forget it! It's easy to make hamburger goulash in your slow cooker with potatoes, onions, and carrots in a richly seasoned beef broth.
ingredient_lines: 1 dash hot sauce (such as Tabasco), or to taste
instruction_lines: Heat a large skillet over medium heat. Cook and stir beef, onions, and bell pepper in the hot skillet until beef is browned and crumbly, 7 to 10 minutes. Drain and discard grease.

Transfer beef mixture to a slow cooker. Add broth, potatoes, carrots, ketchup, Worcestershire sauce, garlic, paprika, hot sauce, and salt. Stir the mixture, making sure potatoes remain submerged in liquid.
Cover and cook on Low for 4 hours.
